git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(luot-sua-giu-du-dem-dung): Add regression tests for three reported gaps

Regression tests for issues observed in crm don-okr-nhap-sai repo on 2026-10-07:

1. AC-1: Out-of-contract findings from round 1 were dropped in round 2
   - Added test to verify carriedFindings are properly preserved from previous rounds
   - Verifies fields (plain, proposal, fromRound) are intact

2. AC-4: Carried ui-check evals lost their frame fields (screenshot, observed, network_observed)
   - Added test to verify frame fields are present in carried eval evidence report blocks
   - Tests that s4-args correctly loads and preserves these fields

3. AC-6..AC-9: thuoc-vat.mjs was counting merge commits from base branch as feature changes
   - Added detailed test that creates 17 unrelated commits in base branch
   - Merges them into feature branch and verifies thuoc count excludes the merge
   - Ensures only actual feature changes are counted

All regression tests pass with current codebase (fixes already in place from commits 8de0b0d and 6119e6ae).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
